messages:
elaine-docs: Hey team — pushing a docs PR with examples for 'privileged access' evidence exports. Need quick alignment on SOC2-friendly phrasing and sample JSON. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742 :eyes:

mike-compliance: :eyes: I'll take a look. Quick Q — do we call the field `actor_id` or `actor_identity` in examples? auditors prefer `actor_id` but we usually use `user_id` in telemetry.

elaine-docs: Good catch. My draft uses `actor_id` to match SOC2 samples, but I can add a note mapping `actor_id` -> `user_id` for internal teams. Example block I'm proposing:

```json
{
  "event": "audit_export_download",
  "actor_id": "acct-12345",
  "actor_role": "admin",
  "resource": "audit/export/2026-03-01",
  "access_method": "console",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-01T18:12:03Z",
  "evidence_ref": "s3://redwood-privileged-exports/ev-20260301-xyz",
  "pseudonymized": true
}
```

jason-eng: Can we avoid including full S3 URIs in the example? Legal usually wants placeholders. Suggest `evidence_ref: \"s3://<bucket>/...\"` or `evidence_ref: \"REDACTED_URI\"`.

sara-legal: Agree — please swap to placeholder. Also add a short sentence: \"Do not include full blob URIs in public docs; reference placeholders and provide retrieval steps internally.\" That satisfies auditors.

elaine-docs: Updated in PR to `evidence_ref: \"REDACTED_URI\"`. Also added note about KMS/HSM: audit exports should be encrypted and keys managed via customer KMS for Private deployments. Anyone want to sanity-check the wording?

mike-compliance: Wording looks good. One minor: change \"should be encrypted\" to \"must be encrypted\" for SOC2 tone, and add a footnote about key rotation cadence (90 days recommended).

elaine-docs: Done. Also added an SDK snippet for listing privileged exports in Python. cc @jason-eng for code review on snippet.

jason-eng: Two tiny tweaks to snippet: use `client.list_exports(page_size=50)` and mention pagination token. Otherwise LGTM.

elaine-docs: Pushed commit addressing pagination. Also added a short migration note: \"If you previously used `audit_log.export_uri`, update to `evidence_ref` and remove any embedded credentials.\" Thoughts?

sara-legal: Good migration note. Add an example of sanitized vs unsanitized entry (one-liner) so customers know what changed.

docbot: PR #742 updated by elaine-docs — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742/commits/6a7f

mike-compliance: Quick check: retention phrase — we currently say \"retention period enforced per customer policy\". Can we be more precise for docs: \"Retention is configurable per-customer; default retention for hosted exports: 90 days\" ?

elaine-docs: I added exact default values in a separate table in the PR (hosted:90d, dedicated:365d, private: configurable). Table in PR.

jason-eng: LGTM from eng. :+1:

sara-legal: :+1: from legal once the placeholder and \"must\" language are in.

elaine-docs: Thanks all — I'll merge after one more compliance sign-off. If no other comments by EOD, merging.

mike-compliance: Approved. Merge away. :shipit:

elaine-docs: Merged and published (v1.12.0). Thanks! :tada:
